About

WordPress engineering for teams that need reliable delivery.

Zahid combines PHP backend depth with production CMS experience, turning design and product requirements into clean, editable, fast WordPress systems.

Process

A simple delivery path from audit to launch.

The workflow keeps decisions visible, code maintainable, and launch risk low for both new builds and existing WordPress platforms.

01

Audit and map

Review goals, content models, plugins, performance data, and the technical constraints that matter before implementation starts.

02

Architect the build

Define the theme, plugin, API, CMS, and deployment structure so the site is editable, maintainable, and ready for growth.

03

Develop cleanly

Implement production-ready WordPress and PHP features with reusable components, focused QA, and clear version control.

04

Optimize and handoff

Tune speed, security, responsive behavior, and publishing workflows before launch, then document the parts clients need to edit.
